long_biography.plain_text:
Owen Alphonsus Morton moved from hospitality and sales into technology entrepreneurship, teaching himself web development and launching Webbiz from a garage. The agency became the starting point for a wider portfolio in online marketing, trading and financial technology. After an eight-figure exit in 2019, he concentrated increasingly on products serving brokers, proprietary-trading firms and retail traders.

Morton co-founded TradeLocker, a web-based trading platform, and FunderPro, a firm that evaluates and funds traders. He also helped build TradesAI and expanded into payment infrastructure, market intelligence and founder partnerships. Based in Dubai, he combines product development, affiliate-led distribution and hands-on scaling across related companies. The portfolio links software, brokerage access, trader funding, analytics and payments.
